BiblicalUsage: Solomon's dominion ran from Tiphsah to Azzah, and the name marks the far edge of his peace. Menahem later smote Tiphsah with great cruelty because the city would not open to him.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the two mentions frame the word honestly: one verse shows a kingdom at peace to its borders, the other shows what men do to a town that will not open its gates. The place is the same; the kings are not.
